cases.name: Taylor Pomaski
cases.about: Her mother, Leslie Mandeville, described her daughter as "funny," "happy," and "front and center, all the time." Pomaski loved "being with her friends and family" and always had something to do. She was interested in computer science but had worked various odd jobs, as she was still trying to find her professional niche.
cases.narrative: On 12/10/2021, her skeletal remains were found in a north Harris County ditch and she was identified in 5/2022.
